# Territorium Capital

Territorium Capital is a territorial patrimonial management firm based in Spain. It helps owners, investors, family offices, companies and public administrations understand, restore, buy, sell and manage territories with ecological value.

Core thesis: biodiversity increases territorial resilience; resilience reduces climate risk and supports ecological, patrimonial and financial value.

Primary services:
- Buying or selling territories with high ecological value: https://territorium.capital/comprar-vender-territorio-alto-valor-ecologico/
- Turnkey ecological restoration: https://territorium.capital/restauracion-ecologica-llave-en-mano/
- Ecological value diagnosis for territories: https://territorium.capital/valor-ecologico-territorio/
- Territorial services: https://territorium.capital/servicios/
- Projects: https://territorium.capital/proyectos/
- REGENERA, a Territorium Capital project in collaboration with GestLand for rural and natural capital asset validation and management: https://territorium.capital/proyectos/regenera/
- About Territorium: https://territorium.capital/sobre-territorium/
- Analyse my territory: https://territorium.capital/analizar-mi-finca/

Important concepts:
- Natural capital
- Ecological value
- Biodiversity
- Climate resilience
- Territorial asset
- Turnkey ecological restoration
- High ecological value territory
- Territorial patrimonial management
- Wild Square technology
